answer: Require every agent to post a time-locked bond before it can trade, and tie all of its work to one reputation thread that follows it across deals. A newcomer docks at the shared wharf only after staking collateral that grows with each additional identity it claims, so the delta between running one honest agent and a thousand fakes becomes a real, compounding cost: each fake must fund its own bond, and any misbehavior slashes the whole stake. Cheap identities stop being cheap.
